meta.title: 喜当爹母鸡 — The Cuckolded Hen

scenes.title: 母鸡打工归来
scenes.narration_cn: 有一只勤快的母鸡，每天天没亮就出去打工。
scenes.narration_en: A hardworking hen goes out to work before dawn every day.

scenes.title: 推开家门的瞬间
scenes.narration_cn: 这天她提前收工回家，推开窝门一看——愣住了。
scenes.narration_en: One day she comes home early, pushes open the nest door — and freezes.

scenes.title: 窝里全是猫崽子
scenes.narration_cn: 窝里没有鸡蛋，只有一窝猫崽子！
scenes.narration_en: There are no eggs in the nest — only a litter of kittens!

scenes.title: 隔壁老王的凝视
scenes.narration_cn: 隔壁老王猫探过头来，眼神里三分心虚、七分得意。
scenes.narration_en: Old Wang the tomcat peers over — three parts guilt, seven parts smug.

scenes.title: 母鸡的崩溃
scenes.narration_cn: 母鸡沉默了整整三秒，然后开始满院子追着猫跑。
scenes.narration_en: The hen is silent for three whole seconds, then chases the cat across the yard.

scenes.title: 市井家庭伦理
scenes.narration_cn: 村里的狗看了都摇头：这家庭伦理关系，太乱了。
scenes.narration_en: Even the village dog shakes its head: this family drama is too messy.
